text: There, special beings arise due to the deeds of those in hell. Those who are distinguished by color, form, size, and strength acquire the designation of Guardians of Hell and others. They transform in such a way that they are seen performing actions, such as waving their hands in two different ways, to instill fear; for example, mountains in the shape of rams coming and going, and thorns in the Shalmali forest turning downward and upward.
